ranking.definition: cosine between the predicted probabilities (sigmoid) and each retrieval row's fingerprint (rankingset rows are L2-normalised on-bit sets)
ranking.rank: strict: retrieval rows with cosine >= cosine(prediction, gold) count against the gold, minus the gold's own row (ties count against)
ranking.comparison: binary-Tanimoto (jaccard) results for the same tables are kept in paper/results/raw-jaccard and tables-jaccard (release; the 2026-10-02 package: raw-jaccard-466, tables-jaccard-466)

checkpoint_selection: per seed, the single early-stopping-best epoch_*.ckpt (max val/mean_cos during training; patience 30, 750-epoch cap) — see paper/checkpoints/<experiment>.json
aggregation: MARINA: mean ± sample std (n-1) over seeds 0/1/2
label: tab:results_main
description: Flagship MARINA on the dereplication (a) and annotation (b) tasks; Base and +Formula delta
training_dataset: MARINA-DB (release, disk Datasets/MARINA-DB, zip sha256 49442996b190d250586fb293d87396c35266ac9813bc61b4eb629abdd83dc868; FP vocab recomputed; NIST23 molecules have no MS/MS)

benchmark.name: MARINA-Bench 456 (journal; experimental NMR + ICEBERG-simulated MS/MS; 10 NIST23 compounds dropped 2026-10-14)

columns.+F: <subset>_formula minus <subset>, per seed, then mean ± std

metrics.(b) annotation: exp-ann@1/5/10 (%) — ECFP4 (Morgan r=2, 2,048 bits) cosine >= 0.8 between the true structure and any of the top-k structures retrieved by the ranker (SPECTRE-paper definition)
